label: v4 position frontend adapter
summary: Framework-neutral reconciliation for chain, PositionManager, token, pool, owner, liquidity and block-hash-bound snapshots with same-block fail-closed consistency.
maturityMeaning: Deterministic reusable source is packaged and hash-bound; project integration, tests and review are still required.
dependencyRequirements: Pinned project-specific PositionManager and StateView adapter
requiredFacts: Bind chain id, exact PositionManager address and generation, token id, PoolId, owner, read block number and read block hash
Require two snapshots for the same canonical block and position identity to report identical liquidity
Reconcile pending modify-liquidity actions against confirmed onchain state
Present token amounts, liquidity and fees as distinct measurements
hardConflictPredicates: A position action can target a different chain, PositionManager, token id, PoolId or owner than the confirmed intent
Two position snapshots at the same block height but different block hashes are treated as one canonical state
Two snapshots for the same block hash and position identity can silently disagree on liquidity
A stale snapshot can overwrite newer confirmed position state
Displayed liquidity or fee value is represented as a guaranteed withdrawable token amount
